name: What are common challenges during a partial home remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are common challenges during a partial home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges during a partial home remodel often include unexpected structural issues uncovered during demolition, delays due to material availability, and managing the project budget. Sometimes, older homes can reveal hidden problems with plumbing, electrical systems, or framing that require additional work and expense. Clear communication with your contractor is crucial to addressing these challenges promptly. Establishing a contingency fund in your budget, typically 10-15% of the total project cost, can help absorb unforeseen expenses. Maine Results, Inc. emphasizes proactive communication to manage expectations and minimize surprises.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges in a partial remodel include unexpected structural issues, material delays, and budget overruns. Maintaining open communication with your contractor and having a contingency fund are key.
